title: Dragon Fox on Floating Isle
description: A vibrant red and orange dragon-fox hybrid with large wings sits on a small grassy floating island, gazing toward a glowing portal. The surreal scene includes a green elephant, a witch on a broom, a fiery green dragon in a circular portal, a giant red chrysanthemum-like creature, and swirling colorful patterns below against a purple background filled with floating eyes.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting of a majestic red-orange dragon-fox hybrid with braided mane and large bat-like wings, sitting on a small grassy floating island with hanging roots. A small green elephant and a witch flying on a broom are nearby. In the background a large circular portal reveals a fiery green dragon and black dragon silhouette. A giant red spiky flower creature floats to the right. The purple sky is filled with floating eyes, hearts, and small creatures. Vibrant swirling colorful patterns on the ground below, psychedelic style with rich detail and luminous colors.
